title: CNMD - RoadTransportSegment schema
description: A segment of a road transport network, aligned with FIWARE Smart Data Models and INSPIRE.

addressLocality.description: The locality, which must correspond to the municipality

addressRegion.description: The NUTS 2 region in which the locality is located

district.description: The administrative district in which the locality is located

type.description: Property. NGSI entity type. It must be RoadTransportSegment.

accidents.description: Property. Number of accidents recorded on the segment during a specific observation period. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

connects.description: Relationship. Road nodes connected by this segment.

crossBorderConnections.description: Relationship. Road segments in other regions connected to this segment.

dailyTrafficVolume.description: Property. Daily traffic volume, normally expressed in vehicles per day. Units:'C62'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

direction.description: Property. Direction of traffic on the segment.

endKilometer.description: Property. Ending kilometre of the segment. Units:'KMT'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

heavyVehiclePercentage.description: Property. Percentage of heavy vehicles. Units:'P1'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

infrastructureElements.description: Relationship. Infrastructure associated with the segment, such as bridges, tunnels and viaducts.

lanes.description: Property. Number of traffic lanes. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

lastMaintenance.description: Property. Date and time of the last maintenance operation. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'.

length.description: Property. Length of the segment. Units:'KMT'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

nextMaintenance.description: Property. Date and time scheduled for the next maintenance operation. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'.

pavementCondition.description: Property. Pavement condition based on the ASTM D6433 Pavement Condition Index.

pavementType.description: Property. Type of pavement on the segment.

refNetwork.description: Relationship. Road network to which the segment belongs.

roadNumber.description: Property. Identifying number of the road. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.

speedLimit.description: Property. Speed limit on the segment. Units:'KMH'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

startKilometer.description: Property. Starting kilometre of the segment. Units:'KMT'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

trafficSignals.description: Relationship. Traffic control elements along the segment, such as traffic lights and signs.

width.description: Property. Width of the carriageway. Units:'MTR'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.
